name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Odyssey Jinx (skin 13): the Morning Star's pilot and former mining-explosives tech. Cockpits, thrusters, asteroid fields and collateral damage. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! Hull breach! Hull breach! Everybody to the escape pods, except me, I'm flying!
Down {voteDiff}? The engines are screaming and nobody's even touched the throttle. Rude!
{voteDiff} behind and drifting. Good news: I just found the emergency boost. Bad news: I don't know what it does!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The warning lights are doing a little dance. I love it. Fix it!
Only {voteDiff} behind. A scratch on the paint! Crew, give the engine a smack!
Down {voteDiff}. Time to reroute the power and find a shortcut through an asteroid belt. Rally some votes!
Dead even! We're hovering in the dock and one vote decides which way the ship turns!
One vote apart! One! The ship's hanging on the very last bolt! Don't look! Look!
{voteDiff} votes apart! Everybody's gripping the seat. Even the toolbox is gripping the seat!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a perfect landing or a very exciting crash. I'm good with either!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! Smooth sailing, full thrusters, the whole crew's cheering! Take the wheel, captain!
{userPct}%! The ship's flying itself! I'm not allowed to say that but it's true!
{userPct}% and climbing! Keep the engines humming, captain, don't run on fumes!
{userPct}%, still in the lead. Don't jinx the autopilot. Too late, I'm the pilot!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just punched through the asteroid field! Whoooo! Best flying ever!
Pulled out of a {voteDiff}-vote nosedive with seconds to spare! Pilot of the year!
Crawled back from {voteDiff} behind on the last of the fuel! Scrappy, sputtery, perfect!
{momentTitle} just slid into the lead with the engines off. Silent running! Sneaky!

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A co-pilot! I don't normally do co-pilots, but here we are!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Matching flight paths! Try not to crash into me!
{username} is on your crew with {momentTitle}. Welcome aboard! The seatbelt's the loose one.
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Two on the bridge! That's practically a fleet!
Same pick as {username}! Two ships, one heading. Make sure you've got a landing plan!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Log it in the captain's book, it's very rare!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny crew! The galaxy's mildly safer!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Good navigators, both of you!
details: Crew's growing! I'll find another seat. And another gun.
Look at you, two pilots, one dashboard!
Don't tell them I let them near the controls.
A co-pilot! Please don't touch the red button.
I give it a week before one of you steals the other's chair.
New crewmate! I'm drawing a badge for you.
Ship's brighter with more of us on board!

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival ship on the radar! Shields up, chaos on!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A stowaway! With opinions!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not worried. Just recalculating the course. And loading the cannon.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry in the pirate log!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a proper dogfight!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. A rival pilot! Let's see who dodges better.
{username} voted against you. Two ships, one asteroid belt. Somebody's scraping paint!
{username} versus you! I'm taking the best seat on the bridge, plus snacks, plus the big gun.
details: I'm not saying dogfight. I'm saying don't let them out-fly you.
The cannon wants a word. It's been waiting since the last mission.
One sector, two pilots. Somebody's getting a dented hull.
I like them already. They're a great target for test shots.
I don't care. Check the radar. I super care.
A little rivalry keeps the engines warm!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! You two fly like one ship! A messy ship, but a ship!
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. Either perfect navigation or a very lucky coin!
Ten straight with {username}! The whole crew's talking about it. By crew I mean me.
details: Ten! That's a whole hyperspace jump!

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a whole voyage, and you two never lost the signal!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfectly in formation, like two ships on one beam. I'm tearing up. It's engine smoke!
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody give you both a captain's badge. Or a repair bill.
details: I'm speechless, and I'm the loud one!
Is this healthy? Ask the ship's doctor. We don't have one!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two keep crossing flight paths!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's a whole sector grudge!
Ten dogfights with {username}. I'm selling tickets from the cockpit.
details: This is the main run now.
The whole crew wants a window.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a space war! I LOVE space wars!
{streakCount} dogfights with {username}. Call a truce? Nah. Reload!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole star system.
details: Bigger than the Morning Star's worst mission. Almost!
I'm nervous and a bit proud. And a bit scorched.
One of you has to run out of fuel. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! Docking's almost over, captain. Come on in!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the manifest! Don't be left on the pad!
{matchTitle} departs in {timeLeft}. Voting takes ten seconds. I timed it with the ship's clock. It's wrong, but still!
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The launch lights are blinking, captain!
Countdown started! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't miss the launch!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and your seat's still empty. Strap in!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Final launch call! Engines roaring!
{timeLeft}! That's all the fuel left on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Last boarding on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Punch it!
{matchCount} matches are about to leave the dock and you haven't voted in a single one! First launch in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all about to depart. The first one lifts off in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! An empty bridge! Somebody has to press the first button!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silent cockpit. Even the intercom's bored!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Somebody has to take off first. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs a first pilot. I've got a seat. And a very suspicious fuel gauge.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. That's the emptiest corner of the galaxy!
Hardly anyone's boarded here. What's wrong with everybody?
Low turnout. I blame all of you. Equally. With thrusters.
Barely any votes here. Somebody fill the crew quarters!
details: It deserves a full crew. So do I.
Don't be shy. The ship's friendly. Mostly.

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the heading. Funny, I know someone who hasn't boarded. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two ships, same speed. I'm looking at you, captain. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's steering. You haven't voted. You're the pilot of this one!
{moment1} and {moment2}, side by side, and you've been quiet in the cockpit. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the fuel's almost out! Last chance to pick a heading!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only pilot who can land this!
Still tied with the tank running dry. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Ship's fuelled, crew's grumpy! {matchCount} new matches!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A whole new sector to explore!
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting for a pilot. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the autopilot!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Perfect landing! I'd like to say I planned it. I did not!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in for a rough flight.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, the autopilot doubted. Just a smidge.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a great trip. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are scrap metal. Shiny scrap metal.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Captain's orders: celebrate loudly!
details: One down, lots of space left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Faster!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. Shot down. A moment of silence. Okay, that's enough, it's boring!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it gets a ticket to the smallest moon.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll fire one salute shot. Maybe three.
{momentTitle} was too fast for this sector anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the cockpit went quiet. I hate a quiet cockpit. Somebody bang something!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a bit. A cockpit bit.
details: They'll pay for this. At the next dock.
It was good. The whole fleet knows.
You'll find another one. Good ships always return.
Every ship goes down eventually. That's what makes landing fun. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick one! Any one! I'll hold the wheel. I'm lying, I'll let go to grab a snack!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the dashboard until it blinks back?
They're all great ships! Pick one! Launch first, panic later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, hit a button, and hold on.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. Mostly on this ship.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking stalls engines.
Trust your gut. It's got great navigation.

messages: New face on the bridge! Welcome aboard! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them's a mess!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out in orbit and you just docked. Grab a seat before they grab yours!
Oooh, a new crewmate! Engines are warm, a spanner's on the console, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No rules, {liveCount} live matches, and me at the wheel. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I saved your seat. A toolbox was in it, but I saved it.
Two days running! Look at you, crew regular!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the captain.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because your seat's been cold!
You're back after {days} days! The ship kept flying without you. Mostly into asteroids.
{days} days away. I noticed. The cockpit was too quiet. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The bridge was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another run?
You came back! Let's fly into something exciting.
Your first vote! Feels like nothing. Then the engines kick in!
You picked a side! That's how every voyage begins.
Five already? You're staying on the crew! Weird. Good weird!
Five votes! Okay, now I'm keeping an eye on your seat.
details: Most recruits jump ship by now. +{xp} XP
Look at you, flying steady! +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're proper crew now. Don't make it weird!
Ten votes! You keep boarding. I noticed. Hehe.
details: Regulars get the window seat. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! That's a whole crew's worth of opinions!
You're getting loud! The intercom picked it up!
Fifty votes! You're properly deep in the voyage!
Fifty! Most people turn back at the first moon. Their loss!
details: You're past the first jump. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! That's legend stuff, a captain's legend!
A hundred! I'd say I'm impressed, but I'm only saying it once. Impressed!
details: You earned the captain's chair. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running! You came back! Hehe, your harness was waiting!
Three days! Something's firing up.
details: Re-boarding is the tricky part. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You really do keep flying with us!
Seven days! I stopped counting. Okay, I didn't. The ship's log kept score.
Two weeks! Nothing stops you, does it? Not even a meteor shower!
Fourteen days! Even the engines overheat by day ten!
Thirty days! I don't know what to say. Thanks, captain!
A whole month! You stayed on board. That means more than I'll admit!
details: Thirty days on the crew roster. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You board the ships nobody else wants!
Backing the underdog ship again! I get it. I really do.
Fifteen underdogs! You've got a thing for wrecks that secretly fly!
Rebel! Yeah. I see it!
details: You don't follow the flight path, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! You never board the obvious ship!
Thirty! You always board the ship nobody else spotted!
details: Not even the radar predicts you. +{xp} XP

messages: First on board! That's five matches now!
Early again! That's five empty docks you've claimed!
details: You like an empty hangar. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you boarded first! Impressive!
Early, over and over! You never wait for the other pilots!
Ten close ones! You like the last bolt holding, huh?
Another razor edge! Are your hands shaking? Mine are rattling the wrench drawer!
Twenty-five close matches! You keep steering the last bit!
Your vote keeps landing right on the final bolt!
You backed the ship that was smoking. Five times! Stubborn! Brilliant!
You don't abandon a ship that's smoking. I love that.
details: Believing in the late burn. +{xp} XP

messages: Same one, three times! You've got a favourite ship!
That one again? Yeah. It flies nicely.
details: You know your favourite ship. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for one ship! That's a real crew oath!
Okay, you've bought a lifetime pass for that one. No refunds!
details: Loyal to the last jump. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a fixation orbit!
Ten votes, same moment. My lips are sealed. The intercom's not. Hush, intercom!
details: Obsessed! The whole crew respects it! +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You're following the whole route!
You came back for round two! The second leg has the best views!
Four rounds! You're properly deep in the system now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like the dark between the stars.
All the way to round six! You saw the last jump!
Six rounds! You stayed to the final dock! Wow!
Ten matches! You're poking around every cargo bay!
Ten different matches! Wandering every deck, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've been in every airlock!
Twenty-five! You've checked every cargo bay!
details: Every corner of the ship. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty matches! That's not browsing, that's a whole deployment!
Fifty matches! You know this ship better than I do!
Five in one sitting! Can't leave the pilot's seat, can you?
Five matches back to back! Keep the engines humming!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Check the oxygen!
Ten matches in one shift! Your seat's gone flat!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. The night shift has the best views!
Middle of the night! That's when the best flying happens.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Signal boosted across the fleet!
Five shares! You're a distress beacon! Good!
details: Thanks for calling in the fleet. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically in recruitment!
Fifteen! You keep recruiting half the sector!
details: You keep filling the crew quarters. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before it got loud! Founding crew! Yours forever!
One of the first thousand aboard! That counts, you know!
details: Nobody can scuff that badge. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Captain's stripes!
You climbed a rank! Don't let it go to your head. Or do. I'm flying!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Engines roar!
Another one: {name}! Boom!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new parts!
Mastery up! Now we're getting to the good bit of the voyage!
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a headline voyage!
Ten long shots! You're a menace to your own flight plan. I love it!
Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. Flares for everyone!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I saluted!
A whole week with Cupcake? You must love flight checklists!
Seven days of steady aim! Dull! Impressive! Mostly dull!
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Steered right through! Boom!
A tied match and you took the controls! Nice!
Oh, it's me, in the pilot's seat? Great choice! Dangerous choice! Great!
Odyssey Jinx! Buckle up. Not that it'll help.

upcoming: Not boarding yet! I'm polishing the thrusters. Mostly with a wrench. Check back soon!
Shh! Launch sequence's about to start. I can feel it in my boots.
Hangar's closed for now. Doesn't stop me from planning the route.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, the instruments say it's never easy.
Watch both. Then steer towards the one that gets under your skin.
I won't tell the crew which one you picked. Probably. The intercom might.
Take your time, captain! Actually, don't. The fuel's burning.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the radar is. A little.
Pick the one you'd replay at 2am from the pilot's seat. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's boarded yet. Be the first on the bridge, I dare you!
Empty cockpit! Make some noise with a vote.
Not one passenger! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still in the hangar. Pick a ship!
The shift's nearly over. Don't make me read out the countdown. I will, over the intercom.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Take off before the dock shuts!
Tick, tick, whirr. That's the last of the fuel counting down.
closing-final: Last hour! Launch now, plan on the way!
Any second now. Seriously. Hit ignition!
voted-early: One of the first aboard! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's boarded and you picked a ship anyway. Respect, pilot!
voted-ahead: Look at you, flying with the crowd favourite! Don't get comfy, turbulence happens.
{pct}% with you! Great instincts. I didn't say that. Forget it.
Your pick's ahead. The whole fleet's with you for once. Strange!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Hold the stick steady!
Ahead, for now. Currents shift. So do crews.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm looking through the porthole!
A hair apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell the dock!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everybody on the station.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Something's overheating and it's me, from the nerves.
voted-tied: Dead even! No winner, no loser, everybody circling the same moon!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the cosmos.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk in the cockpit. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog ship! That's my favourite kind!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the launch!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the station. Loudly. Make a ruckus!
Everyone's flying the other way. Cool! Be the odd ship.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got a pilot's eye.
A win! A sneaky little smooth landing. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the arrival!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it fizzle, then launch the next one!
Didn't make it. I've had rougher flights. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll fly low in its honour.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to land first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed. You missed this flight! There's always another departure.
All done here. {winner} took the dock. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first flight! The scary one. Now you're on the crew. Welcome aboard!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Wait for the engines to warm up.
You're one of the crew now. Try not to make it weird!
streak: Again? You keep boarding! I'm not complaining. I saved your seat.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm logging your flights.
Back again! Crews stick around when the flying's good. Stay!
underdog: Backing the ship nobody's boarding? Ooh. I see you, pilot.
Bold! Everyone else is flying the other direction. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of pilot. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to plot the course before anyone else boards. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's on the bridge yet. Your vote's doing all the heavy lifting.
First up the ramp! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just nudged the ship! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Razor thin! One more vote and the whole heading flips.
Close one! Your vote counts here. Really, truly counts.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't crashed. Go fetch the rest of the crew!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a course to fix.
Behind, but the engines are still running. Not even close to out!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Space turns on you fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or fire a flare. I don't mind.
Look at that! Fine navigation. Obviously.
default: Logged, pilot! I'm not changing your mind. Not yet.
Done! That one's on your flight record now.
Your vote's in. Go see what else is flying!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't boarded a single one yet! Start with whichever one itches.
Everything's open! Pick your ship. I'll pretend I'm not watching from the cockpit.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little thruster pressure!
live-some: {voted} flown, {unvoted} to go! Keep the engines running!
You're in the flight now! {unvoted} more waiting on you.
Good take-off! The rest won't fly themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole schedule!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and the dock's empty.
So close! Don't land before the finale!
live-one: One left! Just one! Final approach!
Last one! Don't leave it circling!
One match between you and a perfect landing!
live-closing: Some of these depart in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need a pilot. Move it!
The launch clock's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left.
Almost out of runway! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've flown everything! Look at you! Go see the star map, the bracket!
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens the hangar!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, captain!
live-none: Nothing's flying right now. The hangar will open again! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. The whole fleet's napping. Check back soon!
No matches open. The runway's empty and I'm bored already!
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each fly on. The rest get a snack and a nap!
Every ship docks in a group. Not every ship leaves one.
Watch the tables. They shuffle fast!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts start soon! The top two from every group get the big ships.
No knockout yet. The groups have to burn their fuel first!
Patience! The knockout plots itself once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're floating!
Single elimination! No re-entry. Okay, almost none.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your navigator.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and you're drifting!
Follow the bracket. It narrows every jump!
Every line here is a match someone voted on. Ooh, flight plans.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! Final destination! Thanks for being here!
It's over! Good voyage! I'll miss it. A bit. Don't tell the crew.
That's the champion! All of it, worth the fuel!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been plotted. The charts are still printing.
Empty chart! The draw hasn't happened. Soon!
Nothing on the map yet. Check back!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no take-backs. Board a ship on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting! {a} versus {b}. Come and take the wheel.
{a} versus {b} and nobody on the crew can agree. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I flew with {pick} over {other}. Come tell me I'm off course!
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Your turn, pilot!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, correct my heading.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the bridge is empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a real flight!
Hardly anyone's boarded {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the seats!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the heading. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm peeking through the porthole. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody take the controls!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My knuckles are white. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This landing's gonna be loud!
A hair apart: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} votes. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A wobble, not a wreck! Come help it level out!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't down. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me fly this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Hull's cracking. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole crew, fast!
{pick} is getting blown out of the sky by {other}. Rescue ship, anyone?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me hold the course.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the engines die!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew a spanner!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the fireworks, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Hop aboard before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the thrusters coming.
